final_message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including both nickname tests.

The schema change is in a new file, `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`, which adds a nullable `nickname` column. The existing migrations already ran in production, so I left them alone. `migrations/README.md` says that directory is owned by the DBA team, so please get their sign-off before this merges.

The change to `src/api/users.js` is small: it stores `nickname ?? null` on insert and returns `nickname: r.nickname ?? null` on read. I haven't committed anything.
